result.competitor: none found locally; generic traceability vendors only (TraceX, per the claim, not verified by me)
result.duty: Intermediary licence, evacuation permit, fixed price, stamped sacks and vehicle permits per ANCA and the Ministry of Commerce. Annual. Penalty: licence withdrawal for buying below the fixed price (2022 item). 2026 ordinance text not found.
result.market: About 2,099 intermediary licences and 500 evacuation permits in 2025, from the claim; not verified by me.
result.reason: The 2026 campaign duty is partly confirmed: Bissau purchase price 478 CFA/kg, 410 CFA/kg to producers, and a zero-tolerance smuggling slogan (noticiasaominuto). Older Lusa items show ANCA rules on stamped sacks and special vehicle permits. I found no current text of the intermediary licence rules, licence fee, penalty or any ANCA licence portal. No local software competitor turned up. The market count (about 2,099 licences) was not independently verified. Weak points: seasonal, informal buyers with low digital literacy, a transition government after the November 2025 coup, and a regulator-driven process that is mostly paper. Overlaps with K02.

Secondary sources (vatupdate, vatcalc, Rivermate) agree VAT started 1 Jan 2025 (Law 4/2022). They say registration is required above 10M XOF and a simplified option at 5% applies for 10-40M XOF. Filing frequency conflicts: monthly by the 15th per vatcalc/Rivermate, quarterly per KPMG's description. I could not confirm the penalties or the rate from primary law. The KPMG URL returned 404 and the Boletim Oficial was not reached. No register count of simplified-regime taxpayers was found. I found no private competitor, but Kontaktu is free. The buyers are informal micro-traders with low willingness to pay and poor reachability, and the regime is optional. The accountant-facing known idea K01 is the better route.

result.competitor: Antares Vision Group (AVGroupHub, National Drug Catalogue), managed by ARFAME
result.duty: National Track & Trace mandate signed 19 Sep 2025; registration for manufacturers, importers, distributors and dispensers; regulation due March 2026. Penalties and frequency not found.
result.market: Not found: no count of licensed pharmacies or importers.
result.reason: A national Track & Trace mandate was signed on 19 Sep 2025. Registration reportedly covers manufacturers, importers, wholesalers, distributors and dispensers, with rules due in March 2026. The state system is delivered by Antares Vision (AVGroupHub, National Drug Catalogue) and managed by ARFAME, so the core job is already done by a state-contracted platform. I found no penalties, no pharmacy scanning duties, no legal instrument, no confirmation the rules took effect, and no pharmacy count. All sources are vendor press or reprints.
